user_intent: 期望 温度 处于 27 ℃ 到 29 ℃
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF miaomiao_air_monitor.reading(Temperature) > 29 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_cool_on() xiaomi_air_conditioner
IF miaomiao_air_monitor.reading(Temperature) < 27 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_heat_on() xiaomi_air_conditioner
IF miaomiao_air_monitor.reading(pm2.5Density) >= 134 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() zhimi_air_fresh
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() zhimi_air_fresh
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_air_conditioner
